title: Queen Palm | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Queen Palm is a 4.00 bedroom, 5.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: This brand-new four-story home is designed for memorable moments, offering ample space to relax, reconnect, and enjoy the best of Inlet Beach. Whether you’re savoring morning coffee on the rooftop terrace, grilling fresh seafood after a beach day, or gathering in the open-concept living area, every detail is crafted for comfort and connection.A short walk to the sugar-white sands and close to the community pool, this home blends coastal luxury with easy access to top dining, shopping, and outdoor adventures. With four spacious bedrooms, four full bathrooms, and two half baths including a convenient garage shower, this retreat comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests.The heart of the home is the second-level living space, where natural light highlights the modern coastal décor. Unwind on plush sofas by the fireplace for a cozy movie night or gather around the dining table for meals prepared in the fully stocked kitchen. Equipped with high-end appliances, a coffee maker, and a toaster, the kitchen island also offers extra seating, perfect for quick breakfasts before heading out. Need to check in on work? A dedicated office space ensures you can stay connected. Step onto the balcony, where a gas grill sets the stage for relaxed evenings with great food and company.The crown jewel of this home is the rooftop terrace, offering panoramic views of Inlet Beach. Start your mornings with the fresh Gulf breeze and in the evening, unwind under the stars with a favorite show on the outdoor TV.Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom 1: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.Bedroom 2: Full-over-full bunk bed, TV. Private bathroom with tub/shower combo.Bedroom 3: Master King bed, TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks and large shower.Bedroom 4: Queen bed, TV. Private access to shared bathroom with shower.Exploring the area is effortless with four complimentary bikes from VacayZen. Ride along scenic 30A pathways to The Big Chill for live music and casual bites, grab a coastal-inspired meal at George’s at Alys Beach, or indulge in a sweet treat at Sugar Shack in Rosemary Beach. Browse upscale boutiques at 30Avenue or stop by Sweet Henrietta’s at Watersound Town Center for fresh pastries.The Inlet Beach neighborhood, Twin Palms, is perfectly located next door to Rosemary Beach and within a few minutes of all the other unique South Walton beach communities. With the opening of the underpass for foot traffic, which goes under highway 98 and allows pedestrians and bikes to safely cross from the north to the south side without dealing with cars, accessing Rosemary Beach is now even easier. This also provides a more convenient way to walk to the beach and nearby shops. You'll find no shortage of things to do with a stay at Majestic Palm.Beach Access:Head back out of the neighborhood towards Wall Street. From the north side, take Wall Street Across Hwy 98 where it will end at your Beach Access, Wall Street Public Beach Access.Distance: .4 miles | Time: 10 minutes walking, 3 minutes bikingInlet Beach:The location can't be beat! You're minutes from 30Avenue where you'll find no shortage of dining and shopping options. If you're looking to explore the area's natural beauty, Camp Helen State Park is practically right next door. Minutes from Rosemary Beach to the west and Panama City Beach to the east, you'll be pleased to have everything you could want on your 30A vacation at your fingertips.Your stay at Queen Palm comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Please note that there is active construction across the street.* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 4 cars (2 in garage).
